name: Great Feature Toggle
author: Geoff Mulligan

sections.description:
Great Feature Toggle allows you to enable/disable WordPress features through an intuitive admin interface. Features are compiled into an optimized static file for maximum performance.

Key Features:
* Performance-optimized compilation system
* Categorized feature organization
* Real-time admin interface
* Robust error handling
* Translation ready
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/great-feature-toggle/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Create your features directory and add feature files
  4. Go to Settings > Great Feature Toggle to configure
sections.faq:
How do I create custom features?

Create PHP files in the includes/features/ directory that return feature arrays.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes! All strings are wrapped in translation functions.
